messages:
Ana (CS): Alert: small number of new signups (approx 7) received activation email but sample content failed to index. Not full outage, but poor first-run UX.

Mike S.: Acknowledged. Can we get a quick cause?

Luis (Eng): Looks like a retry-backoff regression + one oversized partner template. Worker pool hit queue limit.

Ana (CS): Need two comms: short status to affected users + private CSM note offering $50 credit and 30-min enablement call. Olivia can you prepare drafts?

Olivia (CSM): Drafting. Short note will say: we detected indexing failures between 11:05-11:20 UTC; we're reprocessing your sample content and expect restoration in ~30-60m. No action needed. $50 credit applied.

Luis (Eng): Ops plan: restart indexers with reduced concurrency and trigger rate-limited reindex endpoint. Will add estimated_restore_minutes to job response for CS.

status-bot: Reindex job queued for 7 tenants (job-6721).

Mike S.: Running reindex now, posting quick checks.

Mike S.: 4/7 restored.

Mike S.: 7/7 restored. Final smoke looks good.

Ana (CS): Communications plan: Olivia publishes general note, CSMs send private follow-ups + schedule enablement if requested, credits applied. Add two-question pulse post-session.

Luis (Eng): I'll follow up with a permanent fix PR and a short RCA for #postmortems.

Ana (CS): Thanks team, closing this thread for active ops. Will post customer completion update in 20m.
